ideas.title: Voice-Activated Task Creation
ideas.description:
Allow users to create tasks using voice commands for hands-free productivity

**Findings**: Market research shows 68% of mobile users prefer voice input for quick actions. Voice-activated productivity is growing 45% YoY. Main competitor (Todoist) lacks robust voice features.
dependencies: Natural language processing for task parsing

aiStudio.nextSteps: Prototype voice UI, test with 50 beta users, validate task accuracy >90%

ideas.title: AI-Powered Priority Suggestions
ideas.description:
Use machine learning to automatically suggest task priorities based on user behavior, deadlines, and context

**Findings**: Exploratory concept. Requires significant ML infrastructure and training data. Uncertain ROI. Similar features in competitors show mixed adoption (15-40%).

aiStudio.nextSteps: Run feasibility spike, estimate infrastructure costs, interview 20 users about priority pain points

ideas.title: Collaborative Team Workspaces
ideas.description:
Enable teams to share task lists, assign work, and track progress collaboratively

**Findings**: Strong customer demand from enterprise segment. 82% of trial users requested team features. Competitive requirement for enterprise deals. Clear monetization path (team plans).

aiStudio.nextSteps: Finalize architecture design, scope MVP team features, estimate 8-10 week timeline

ideas.title: Offline Mode Support
ideas.description:
Allow users to access and modify tasks without internet connection, with automatic sync when online

**Findings**: Moderate demand (32% of users report connectivity issues). Critical for mobile users and travelers. Implementation complexity high due to conflict resolution.

aiStudio.nextSteps: Research offline-first frameworks (e.g., PouchDB, WatermelonDB), prototype conflict resolution
